T: Bring a compass that points to dinner.
D: Jack Sparrow owes Davy Jones a soul and goes hunting for the chest that holds Jones's heart.
P: Serve the snacks when the crew sits down to play liar's dice on the Flying Dutchman.
S: Liar's dice halloumi with chilli honey
Pan-fried halloumi cubes with warm chilli honey, lemon and thyme

Halloumi cut into dice, fried golden and crisp, tipped out of a cup and drizzled with chilli honey, lemon and fresh thyme. Cut 2 x 180g blocks halloumi into 2cm cubes and pat dry. Toss in 2 tbsp plain flour. Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat and fry the cubes for 1 minute a side until golden all over. Warm 4 tbsp honey with 1 tsp chilli flakes. Pile the halloumi into a cup, tip onto a board like a throw of dice, drizzle with the chilli honey, a squeeze of lemon and thyme leaves.
Pork and pineapple skewers glazed with chilli lime honey, grilled over coals
Pork and pineapple skewers glazed with honey, chilli and lime, grilled over coals until sticky and charred.
Tia Dalma's chicken and sausage gumbo
Tia Dalma's hut up the swamp river

Chicken and smoky sausage simmered in a dark roux with okra, capsicum, celery and onion, ladled over rice with spring onion. Stir 80ml oil and 80g plain flour in a heavy pot over medium heat for 20 minutes until the roux is dark brown. Add 1 diced onion, 1 green capsicum and 2 celery sticks and cook 5 minutes. Add 500g diced chicken thighs, 300g sliced smoked sausage, 2 tsp Cajun spice and 1L chicken stock. Simmer for 45 minutes, adding 200g sliced okra for the last 15. Serve in cups over 300g cooked rice with sliced spring onion.
M: Potatoes, corn, prawns and mussels boiled with paprika, garlic and lemon, garlic butter
Prawns, mussels, corn and potatoes boiled with paprika, garlic and lemon, tipped onto paper with melted butter.
Tortuga jerk chicken with rice and peas
Recruiting a crew in Tortuga, Jack doing the picking

Chicken thighs in a Scotch bonnet, allspice and thyme marinade, charred on the grill, with coconut rice and kidney beans. Blitz the spring onion, chilli, allspice, thyme leaves, soy and lime juice and rub over the chicken. Grill or roast at 200°C until charred and cooked through. Simmer the rice with the coconut milk, beans, 250ml water and salt, covered, until tender.
W: Dark chocolate ganache tart with sea salt flakes on a cocoa pastry
Dark chocolate ganache tart in a cocoa pastry shell, set overnight, with sea salt flakes on top.
K: Chilled hibiscus, ginger and clove drink over ice, dark rum for adults
Deep red Caribbean hibiscus drink brewed with ginger, cloves and orange peel, served over ice.

s.n: Liar's dice halloumi with chilli honey
s.note: Pan-fried halloumi cubes with warm chilli honey, lemon and thyme
s.how: Cut 2 x 180g blocks halloumi into 2cm cubes and pat dry. Toss in 2 tbsp plain flour. Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat and fry the cubes for 1 minute a side until golden all over. Warm 4 tbsp honey with 1 tsp chilli flakes. Pile the halloumi into a cup, tip onto a board like a throw of dice, drizzle with the chilli honey, a squeeze of lemon and thyme leaves.

s.note: Pork and pineapple skewers glazed with chilli lime honey, grilled over coals
s.how: Cut 500g pork scotch fillet and half a pineapple into chunks and thread onto skewers. Warm 3 tbsp honey with a chopped red chilli and lime juice. Grill the skewers over hot coals, brushing with the glaze, until sticky and charred on all sides.

m.note: Potatoes, corn, prawns and mussels boiled with paprika, garlic and lemon, garlic butter
m.how: Boil 800g baby potatoes in salted water with smoked paprika, garlic and lemon for 15 minutes. Add 4 halved corn cobs for 5 minutes, then 500g green prawns and 1kg mussels for 4 minutes. Drain, tip onto paper and pour over melted garlic butter.

w.note: Dark chocolate ganache tart with sea salt flakes on a cocoa pastry
w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case with a spoon of cocoa rubbed into the pastry. Heat 300ml cream and pour over 300g chopped dark chocolate, stirring until glossy. Pour into the case and chill overnight. Sprinkle with sea salt flakes before slicing.

d.note: Chilled hibiscus, ginger and clove drink over ice, dark rum for adults
d.how: Steep 30g dried hibiscus, a knob of sliced ginger, 4 cloves and orange peel in 1.2L boiling water for 30 minutes. Strain, stir in 120g sugar and chill. Serve over ice, with a splash of dark rum for the grown-ups.
